About the Host University

International Business School (IBS) – Budapest, Hungary

Established in 1991, International Business School (IBS) is a private higher education institution located in Budapest, the capital of Hungary, known for its international learning environment and industry-oriented education. IBS offers British degree programmes in collaboration with the University of Buckingham, UK, with a focus on business, management, finance, and technology. Its modern campus, located in the Graphisoft Park technology and business hub, provides students with exposure to an international corporate environment, with companies such as Microsoft and SAP operating nearby. IBS emphasises practical learning, industry relevance, and international career development.

Location

About Hungary

Budapest, Hungary – A European Hub of Education, Innovation and Architecture

Budapest, the capital of Hungary, is one of Central Europe’s most beautiful and historic cities, renowned for its architectural heritage, modern infrastructure, and quality education. Divided by the Danube River, the city is famous for its magnificent Hungarian Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and Széchenyi Chain Bridge. Hungary has contributed remarkable inventions to the world, including the Rubik’s Cube, invented by Hungarian architect Ernő Rubik, and the holography technique, pioneered by Nobel Prize-winning scientist Dennis Gabor. Budapest is also a growing hub for information technology, artificial intelligence, engineering, and multinational companies, offering international students a vibrant environment for education, innovation, and cultural exposure.
